about: Battle-screen lettering in /PS3_GAME/USRDIR/DATA/BTLC/CMN.CPK member 0 (GTF at 0xa400). tools/cmn_art.py renders each label whose "en" is filled; null leaves the Japanese art untouched. Geometry and style are fixed in the tool; only the wording lives here. Already-English textures (t1 ribbon, t4 HP/EN gauge, t14 CRITICAL, t23 Center/Wide/ALL/MAXIMUM/Main/Assist/BREAK word atlas) are not listed.

maximum_break.evidence: eboot.json: マキシマムブレイクを使用 = Use Maximum Break; the game's own ribbon t1 and word atlas t23 read MAXIMUM BREAK.
maximum_break.note: Drawn as nine animated cells MA|XI|M|U|M|B|R|EA|K; other wording needs a new cell plan in the tool.

combo_attack.evidence: eboot.json 合体攻撃 = Combo Attack (reuse:jigoku).

counter.evidence: rpw_names.json skill カウンター = Counter; eboot.json 「カウンター」発生時 = When Counter triggers.

attack_again.evidence: eboot.json ・再攻撃時使用可能 = - Attack Again OK; Jigoku's banner.
attack_again.note: Re-Attack, matching the skill name in rpw_names.json (orchestrator 2026-10-02).

support_attack.evidence: eboot.json （援護攻撃ＯＮ／ＯＦＦ） = (Toggle Support Attack); ・援護攻撃時使用可能 = - Support Attack OK.

support_defense.evidence: eboot.json （援護防御ＯＮ／ＯＦＦ） = (Toggle Support Defense); the voice/script corpus uses "support defense" throughout. Jigoku's banner said Support Defend, which this project does not use.
support_defense.note: Rendered fresh (not Jigoku's pixels); one letter longer, condensed a little more.
